test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 1 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

We would have loved to stay __________ like children all our lives.
solution:
The correct answer is: **innocent**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.

 
 
• **Innocent **means free from moral wrong; without sin; pure. (मासूम)
